name: MIPLIB 2017 open instance eva1aprime6x6opt
description: Find a feasible solution of the MIPLIB 2017 instance eva1aprime6x6opt with as low an objective value as possible (a maximisation model is negated, so that lower is better for every instance). A solution is feasible when every variable bound, every row bound and the integrality of every integer variable hold within an absolute tolerance of 1e-6 on the values as they are returned; integer variables are not rounded first.
contract: solve(model) -> numpy array of num_cols values, one per column. model has name, mps_path (the uncompressed MPS file), num_cols, num_rows, A (scipy CSR matrix of the rows), col_cost, col_lower, col_upper, row_lower, row_upper, integrality (bool array), offset, maximise and indicators (a list of (row, column, value): such a row has to hold only when that column equals the value; empty for most instances). Score: col_cost @ x + offset in minimisation form (negated when maximise is true), minimized; an infeasible vector is invalid.
notes: Listed objective -18.101469789649965 (in the model's own sense).
MILP for generating structures with negative thermal expansion coefficients, submitted by Yoshihiro Kanno; the grid size in the name is the only size information.
